title: While im waiting for WoW Forever to come out i vibe coded a Plants vs Zombies style game in the WoW universe.
author: unlikely-ape
selftext: Well... I can't wait to play Forever and enjoy some WoW content, but until it does i was building my own mini game. So i took some of my blender, godot and wow export knowledge of the years, got myself a good old Opus 5.5 and started building a game that sort of like a blend of PvZ and WoW (and yes i know about Peacebloom VS. Ghouls, i have the achi...). Basically you need to defend various parts of Eastern Kingdom with your units. So far i have hunters and militias as your defense and orcs and trolls attacking you. Not sure if it's worth sharing but i thought it might. I added harvest golems as lane defense as last resort. There are various daytime and weather options already. And now im working on more units and more maps. If anyone has ideas what to build next let me know!
